Circles in Equilateral Triangle

Problem Family Code: cirinttt • Inner Shape: circle • Container: triangle (arbitrary)

31 Problems 1 Optimal

Requirement Specification (cirinttt.md)

# cirinttt: Circles in Truncated Triangle (TTT) Family: N_CIRCLE_in_TTT (N circles inside a TTT-shaped container). 1. Geometry: - WHEN inner is "CIRCLE" and container is "TTT" THEN: - circles SHALL be represented consistently. - container SHALL use a clearly defined TTT shape. - Scaling SHALL be derived from S via a documented rule. 2. Validity: - WHEN a solution is generated THEN: - all circles SHALL be inside the TTT container. - no two circles SHALL overlap beyond tolerance (≤ 1e-15). 3. Friedman Comparison: - WHEN comparing to Friedman THEN: - use an explicit, documented conversion from S to his unit. - NEW_BEST is valid only if geometry and metric alignment are confirmed. 4. Test Expectations: - Tests SHALL include: - construction of both shapes. - a valid packing. - an overlapping pair. - a boundary-violation case.
